verdict.rationale: GitLab's first-party evidence is a single marketing line saying agents "review code" while the team stays in control, plus general Duo Agent Platform and Chat access to merge requests. The concrete AI code-review capability shown in merge requests comes from third-party partners: CodeAnt AI for AI-native MR reviews and Greptile for PR analysis that surfaces bugs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of an AI merge-request reviewer, evidence that it suggests or applies fixes inline during review, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
